title: Dinosaur Sizes
keyIdea: Dinosaurs came in a huge range of sizes. Compsognathus was about the size of a chicken, and Velociraptor about the size of a turkey. T. rex was about as long as a bus, Diplodocus more than 2 buses long, and Brachiosaurus taller than a house. Book pictures are not real size, so compare with things you know. Longest is not always tallest, and longer, taller and heavier compare different things.
familyTip: Measure a dinosaur outside. Pace out 12 big steps on a path for T. rex and stand at each end. Then try Compsognathus: less than one big step. Ask which dinosaur would fit in your room, and which would not fit in your street.

visual.caption: Longer or shorter than a bus? Drag each card, or tap it and then tap a box.

lab.caption: Flagship lab: put book dinosaurs on a road beside a bus, measure long and tall, size up a film raptor, weigh with elephants, pick size words.

kid: Not all dinosaurs were big. Compsognathus was about as big as a chicken. Velociraptor was about as big as a turkey.
Some were giants. T. rex was about as long as a bus. Diplodocus was more than 2 buses long. Brachiosaurus was taller than a house.
In a book, a tiny dinosaur and a giant can look the same size. To see real size, put them next to a bus, a house or you.
Long is not the same as tall. Diplodocus was the longest, but Brachiosaurus was taller. We say longer, taller or heavier to compare.
adult: Ages 5 to 7. Young children love naming dinosaurs, and size is a good way into comparing and measuring. Key words: size, length, height, weight, longer than, shorter than, taller than, heavier than, about, fossil.

Sizes come from fossil skeletons and are estimates, so say 'about'. Rounded figures from the Natural History Museum: Compsognathus 0.7 m long and 3 kg; Velociraptor about 2 m long with its tail, but only 0.5 m tall at the hips; Triceratops about 9 m; T. rex 12 m long and about 7 tonnes; Diplodocus about 26 m. Brachiosaurus stood about 12 to 13 m tall. A double-decker bus is about 11 m long.

Common mistakes: thinking every dinosaur was huge, trusting book pictures drawn to fill the page, and thinking the longest must be the tallest. Films are another trap: their raptors are as tall as a grown-up, but a real Velociraptor reached about knee height. Be careful with the words too: longer, taller and heavier compare different things.

In the lab your child moves book pictures onto a road beside a bus, measures Diplodocus and Brachiosaurus, picks the animal closest in size to a real Velociraptor and Compsognathus, weighs T. rex and Diplodocus against elephants on a see-saw, and fills sentence gaps with size words.

practice.prompt: A bus is about 11 m long. A long-necked dinosaur was about {a} m long. How many metres longer than the bus was it?
practice.hint: Take the bus length, 11 m, away from the dinosaur's length.
practice.explain: {a} take away 11 is {=a-11}, so the dinosaur was about {=a-11} m longer than the bus.

practice.prompt: A big elephant weighs about 6 tonnes. How many tonnes do {a} big elephants weigh?
practice.explain: {a} elephants of about 6 tonnes each make about {=a*6} tonnes.

practice.prompt: Which dinosaur was about the size of a chicken?
practice.hint: Think of the smallest one in the lab.
practice.explain: Compsognathus was only about 70 cm long and weighed about 3 kg, like a chicken.

practice.prompt: Diplodocus was the longest. Brachiosaurus was ...
practice.hint: Brachiosaurus held its head high up, like a giraffe.
practice.explain: Brachiosaurus was taller, at about 12 m. Diplodocus was longer. Longest is not tallest.

practice.prompt: In a book, T. rex and Velociraptor are drawn the same size. What is true?
practice.hint: Book pictures are drawn to fit the page.
practice.explain: T. rex was about 12 m long. Velociraptor was about 2 m, the size of a turkey. Pictures are not real size.

pool.prompt: Were all dinosaurs bigger than a bus?
choices: No, some were as small as a chicken
pool.explain: Dinosaurs came in many sizes. Compsognathus was about chicken-sized.

pool.prompt: How big was a real Velociraptor?
choices: About as big as a turkey
pool.hint: Films make it bigger than it was.
pool.explain: A real Velociraptor was about turkey-sized, reaching about knee height on a grown-up.

pool.prompt: T. rex was about 12 m long. A bus is about 11 m. T. rex was ...
choices: about as long as a bus
pool.hint: 12 m and 11 m are only 1 m apart.
pool.explain: 12 m is close to 11 m, so T. rex was about as long as a bus.

pool.prompt: On a see-saw, T. rex goes down and 1 big elephant goes up. Which is true?
choices: T. rex was heavier than the elephant
T. rex was lighter than the elephant
T. rex was taller than a house
pool.explain: The heavy side goes down, so T. rex was heavier than 1 big elephant.

pool.prompt: A real Velociraptor was about 50 cm tall at the hips. A child is about {a} cm tall. How many cm taller is the child?
pool.hint: Take 50 away from the child's height.
pool.explain: {a} take away 50 is {=a-50}, so the child is {=a-50} cm taller. Real raptors were small.

pool.prompt: Which word fits? "Brachiosaurus was ___ a house."
pool.hint: It held its head about 12 m up.
pool.explain: A house is about 8 m tall and Brachiosaurus about 12 m, so it was taller than a house.

pool.prompt: Diplodocus was longer than Brachiosaurus. Was it taller too?
pool.hint: Long and tall measure different ways.
pool.explain: Longer is about length and taller is about height. Brachiosaurus was taller.

pool.prompt: Compsognathus was about 70 cm long. Your arm is about {a} cm long. How many cm longer was Compsognathus?
pool.hint: Take your arm length away from 70.
pool.explain: 70 take away {a} is {=70-a}, so Compsognathus was {=70-a} cm longer than your arm.
